clauses.reason: This clause (the lead-in and amendment (I), the substituted section 4(a)(1) up to its OCR break) terminated on 1980-06-27 when Executive Order 12220 (45 FR 44245, Federal Register of July 1, 1980), section 1-501, provided: "Executive Order N o. 10900 o f January 5,1961, as am ended, is revoked." The amendments made by EO 11036 were part of EO 10900 as amended, so that revocation reached them; EO 12220 delegates the same kinds of functions anew in sections 1-401 and 1-405. Mechanism: express revocation of the amended parent order. EO 12220 has no effective-date wording, so the signing date 1980-06-27 is recorded; the publication date 1980-07-01 is the alternative reading.

research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 11036 (27 FR 6653, Federal Register of July 13, 1962), signed by John F. Kennedy and dated July 11, 1962; number, date and subject agree with the census register (Administration of the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act of 1954, as amended). Inventory: the dossier splits the order into two contiguous clauses at an OCR break inside the substituted section 4(a)(1) (the second clause begins with a sentence fragment labelled Section 104). Together they cover amendments (I), (II) and (III) and the signature; I confirm the inventory as complete and decide both clauses as parts of one amending order. The order further amends Executive Order 10900 of January 5, 1961, as amended: (I) it substitutes a new section 4(a), under which foreign currencies accruing under Title I may be used for section 104 purposes, the Director of the Bureau of the Budget fixes the amounts and notifies the Secretary of the Treasury, and the section 104 waiver function is delegated to the Secretary of State for section 104(e) and to the Director of the Bureau of the Budget otherwise; (II) it inserts a new paragraph (5) in section 4(d) assigning section 104(s) purposes to the Department of the Treasury in consultation with the Department of State and delegating the terms-and-conditions function to the Secretary of the Treasury; (III) it substitutes a new section 4(d)(7) assigning section 104(g) purposes to the Department of State and delegating the loan-manner function to the Secretary of State. Ending: EO 12220 section 1-501 revokes EO 10900 as amended on 1980-06-27. The cited source is the held Federal Register text of EO 12220; the dossier's located-provision record for this pair is an American Presidency Project transcription and is not cited. Searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes (all three complete, no coverage warning): the U.S. Code release point 119-121 and eCFR searches record no citation of this order; the Federal Register catalog disposition notes (two machine hits) are the note on this order recording its revocation by EO 12220 and the note recording this order's amendment of EO 10900. EO 12553 does not list 11036 (its held text was searched).

None of these changes the text this order inserted, so none is an event or end for these clauses. The held text of Executive Order 11836, which the dossier lists as citing this order by number, prints the number 11036 over a different subject (the Transportation Cargo Security Program) and mentions neither EO 10900 nor the Agricultural Trade Development and Assistance Act, so it is not an event for this order. The first end shown by held evidence is section 1-501 of EO 12220, effective 1980-06-27.","independent_command_check":"Each clause only amends EO 10900; none is a command independent of that order. savings.reason: EO 12220, which revoked EO 10900 as amended, delegates functions of the same kinds anew: section 1-401(a) on the use of foreign currencies, with the Director of the Office of Management and Budget fixing the amounts and notifying the Secretary of the Treasury; section 1-401(b) delegating the section 104 waiver function to the Director of the United States International Development Cooperation Agency for section 104(e) and to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget otherwise; section 1-405(a) delegating the function of determining the manner in which loans under paragraph (f) of section 104 shall be made; section 1-405(b) delegating the function of prescribing terms and conditions under paragraph (j) of section 104 to the Secretary of the Treasury in consultation with the Secretary of State. EO 12220 cites paragraphs (f) and (j) where this order cited 104(g) and 104(s); whether those are the same statutory paragraphs relettered is not shown by a held statute and is not relied on. EO 12220 has no express savings clause, and no U.S. Code, eCFR or catalog hit shows any other continuing effect of this order.
